description.en:
First Person Cameras
Two separate effects, each with its own keybind:
ON FOOT (default Right Ctrl + B) Adds head movement to the first person view - footstep bob, body sway, a slow handheld drift, breathing while you stand still, and a knee-bend jolt when you land from a fall or a jump.
IN A VEHICLE (default Right Ctrl + N) Simulates a suspended seat. Instead of your head being welded to the cab, the seat and your body lag behind as the tractor pitches, rolls and bounces, then settle back. You lean into corners, rock forward under braking, and get a shove in the back when the machine drops into a rut. Engine vibration comes through the seat too.
Everything is tunable from the game's Settings page, including turning individual parts of each effect down or off. Purely visual - no gameplay or multiplayer impact.
